content:
As of October 8, 2021, the latest news about NVIDIA is that the company's deal to acquire UK-based chip designer ARM Ltd. is facing increasing opposition. On October 7, 2021, Alphabet Inc.'s Google and Microsoft Corp. joined Qualcomm Inc. in expressing concern to the U.S. regulator over the acquisition. Their opposition to the $40 billion deal puts them in line with China and regulators in UK and EU who flagged the deal could undermine the market.

In other news, the firm announced its October 2021 GPU Technology Conference which will showcase various advances in AI, healthcare, graphics, and much more.
